metric_scale: retain 0..1 raw values; display x100; difference from unrounded raw values
estimand: unweighted question mean; question denominator 226; retain all unavailable-gold questions
new_inference: none; copy existing exploratory percentile CI; no new subgroup CI, tests, or interaction claims

A3.discordance: strict opposite signs of F1 and LF or Token F1; directional mismatch with ties also retained

A4.canonical: literal hierarchy + content; no whitespace/Unicode/date normalization
A4.gold_unit: unique canonical gold within each question; query-gold occurrence denominator; not unique corpus-wide gold
A4.row_ids: zero-based original corpus rows; JSONL lines are row_id + 1
A4.duplicates: original rows preserved; evaluation sets deduplicated by exact canonical string
A4.scope: fixed CE and Jev; raw index-error reference is excluded from pool-correct stage attribution
A4.pool_constraint: one final selection per generated-provision pool; exact bipartite maximum matching is a structural bound, never a new prediction

A5.context: newline join of actual provision list, including duplicates
A5.prompt: exact upstream SYSTEM_PROMPT + two newlines + INSTRUCTION_PROMPT substitution; user message only; verify original API cache digest
A5.input: stored generation_trace.usage.input_tokens is full API input; tokenizer text count separately excludes chat framing
A5.output: stored successful API response output_tokens, including original response framing; answer text token count separately
A5.cache: execution cached flag differs from provider cached_input_tokens; cached usage describes demand, not new billing
A5.statistics: mean, median, Q1/Q3/IQR; numpy quantile method=linear; paired Jev-minus-CE differences
A5.cost: no online cost/latency superiority estimate; uncached successful generation usage is not whole-experiment billing

A6.labels: multi-label question observations; counts may exceed 226; no legal error or support verdict

low_auto_answer_threshold.interpretation: arbitrary descriptive screening threshold, not validated correctness boundary

buckets.metric_discordance: strict opposite F1 vs LF/Token F1 signs

A6.selection: nearest to within-bucket median of primary key; ties lexicographic query_id; win/loss/discordance key=abs(F1 delta); common-low key=mean F1; repeat within hop x mapping strata for alternatives
A6.main_candidates: one improvement, one CE advantage, one discordance (fallback common-low); candidates only; pending legal review
A6.human_sample: existing 60-question sample is preserved and never replaced
